title: OpenStax says toddlers who have the understanding enjoy hide and seek
summary: OpenStax says toddlers about 12 to 24 months old enjoy games like hide and seek because they have mastered object permanence.
body: OpenStax Psychology says that because toddlers, about 12 to 24 months old, have mastered object permanence, they enjoy games like hide and seek. The textbook presents the enjoyment as a consequence of that mastery. It is a description in a development chapter, not a US milestone line and not a rule that every toddler likes the game.

sources.title: OpenStax Psychology, 9.3 Stages of Development
sources.author: OpenStax
sources.note: OpenStax Psychology web page, CC BY 4.0. Paraphrase; credit OpenStax. Supports the hide-and-seek sentence about toddlers 12 to 24 months old.
